paper_title: First indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin
notes: Paper presents first indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin using NuSTAR X-ray observations. The primary result (Fig. 2) shows limits on axion-photon coupling g_agamma with g_aee = 0 at 90% CL. Data points extracted from the CLs limit curve (most stringent in most parameter space) in Fig. 2, which constrains keV-mass axions produced in the Solar core and decaying to photons. The paper also constrains axion-electron coupling (g_aee) and presents results in the universal coupling plane (g_agamma = α/2πf, g_aee = m_e/f), but the primary new limits are on the photon coupling. The analysis uses three independent limit-setting methodologies (Poisson, Yellin optimum cuboid, and CLs), with CLs being most stringent. Limits improve on stellar cooling bounds by over an order of magnitude in the 5-30 keV mass range. | selector: text (sole candidate)
